snippet.title: Jackie Tapes - Story Trailer
snippet.description:
JACKIE TAPES ON MODDB: https://www.moddb.com/mods/jackies-tapes 

Follow the path of Doctor Purnell. The doctor who, with his mistakes, created Jackie, the main antagonist of the Epilogue, and traumatized Simon, the protagonist of the Epilogue. Overcome his fears, regrets, and vices to kill Jackie and correct his mistakes.

Explore the burnt-out hospital in SINNER, help Simon in NO TIME FOR DEATH, fight in abandoned hotel in EVICTION, and the final battle to Jackie in MARTYR.

Find out more about the project:
https://www.moddb.com/mods/jackies-tapes
https://vk.com/rrg_dev
Fight for your life. #JackieTapes #CryofFear #EpilogueRemake
Music: Apocalyptica - World's Collide
